name: My Homestay Demons
source:
Your ordinary high school life takes an unexpected turn when two beautiful women arrive from overseas to stay with your family.
The first is Lilith, a fiery, sharp-tongued beauty who acts like she owns the place. The second is Azelia, an elegant and alluring woman whose gentle smile hides a mysterious charm.
Living under the same roof as these two sounds like a dream come true ― until you discover their shocking secret.
One night you catch them performing a strange ritual on your parents. More unbelievable still, both women have horns growing from their heads. They are demons.
When they try to cast the same spell on you, something extraordinary happens. Their magic fails, and fragments of a forgotten past come flooding into your mind. A magnificent throne, a kingdom of demons, and two familiar women standing faithfully at your side.
Could you really be the reincarnation of the Demon King?
As your lost memories slowly return, Lilith and Azelia become determined to awaken your former powers. But their devotion seems to hide feelings far deeper than simple loyalty.
Between Lilith’s adorable tsundere outbursts and Azelia’s irresistible affection, your once-peaceful home turns into a battlefield of romance, jealousy, and supernatural chaos. And when danger from the demon world threatens your new life, you will have to decide what truly matters.
Will you reclaim your throne as the Demon King, or choose a future filled with love?
Two beautiful demons, one unforgettable past, and a romance that transcends lifetimes. Your devilishly sweet love story begins.

[From [url=https://www.facebook.com/100066796552162/posts/1440429914860213]Facebook[/url]]
translation:
当两位来自海外的绝色美女住进你家寄宿时，你平凡的高中生活迎来了意想不到的转折。
第一位是莉莉丝，一位脾气火爆、言辞犀利的美人，举手投足间仿佛她才是这栋房子的主人；第二位是阿泽莉娅，优雅迷人的气质与温柔的微笑背后，隐藏着神秘莫测的魅力。
与这两位佳人同住一个屋檐下听起来简直如梦似幻——直到你撞破了她们惊人的秘密。
某天深夜，你撞见她们正在对你父母施展古怪的仪式。更令人难以置信的是，两名女子的头顶竟然都长着角——她们竟是恶魔。
当她们试图对你施展同样的咒术时，不可思议的事情发生了。她们的魔法失效了，被遗忘的前世记忆碎片如潮水般涌入你的脑海：宏伟的王座、恶魔的国度，以及忠心耿耿侍立在你身旁的两道熟悉倩影。
难道你真的是魔王的转世？
随着失落的记忆一点点复苏，莉莉丝与阿泽莉娅下定决心要唤醒你昔日的力量。然而在她们虔诚的奉献背后，似乎还藏着远超单纯效忠的深切情愫。
在莉莉丝可爱的傲娇发作与阿泽莉娅令人难以抗拒的温柔攻势之间，你原本平静的家庭化作了爱恋、醋意与超自然骚乱交织的修罗场。而当来自魔界的危机威胁到你的新生活时，你必须决定什么才是最珍贵的事物。
你是会重登魔王宝座，还是选择充满爱意的未来？
两位美艳恶魔，一段铭心刻骨的前世，以及一场跨越轮回的恋情。属于你的恶魔般甜美恋曲就此揭幕。
